narrative.overview: A warm, restrained interface built from readable type, aligned data, and ruled surfaces. Hierarchy comes from weight, spacing, and contrast.
keyCharacteristics: One type family, tabular figures, and static line icons.
Flat cream surfaces, near-black ink, and restrained teal interaction states.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo for headings, body text, controls, and numbers. Weight and tracking create hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with borders, spacing, and tonal changes. Surfaces have no shadows or hover lift.

dos: Do reuse the semantic theme variables and existing component styles.
Do pair color states with readable labels or explicit control states.
Do keep numeric columns aligned and actions reachable on small screens.
donts: Don't add display typefaces, gradients, surface shadows, or looping icon motion.
Don't turn every record into a card or every label into a badge.
